status.note: Chosen because its value is a NUMBER IN A RANGE — not a boolean, not one of a fixed set, and not a set of identities. Sourced from the W3C ARIA APG slider pattern, which is normative and complete.

intent.purpose: Chooses a number from a continuous range where the approximate value matters more than the exact one — a volume, a zoom level, a price ceiling.
behaviour: Holds one number between a minimum and a maximum, moving in steps.
Moves by one step on the arrow keys, by a larger jump on Page Up and Page Down, and to the ends on Home and End.
Follows the pointer while dragging, snapping to the nearest step.
Never reports a value outside its range, and never one between steps.
Announces the number, and where a bare number would be meaningless — a rating, a date — announces text instead.
notFor: An exact number a person knows already. Typing '47' is faster and more accurate than dragging to it; use a number field, or pair the two.
A range with two ends. That is a second thumb, a second value, and a set of rules about which one can pass which — a different contract.
Choosing from a handful of options. Steps that are few enough to name are a radio group, where every choice is visible and labelled.
Anything where being one step out matters. A slider cannot be operated precisely on a touch screen.

value.description: The chosen number. Bounded and stepped — facts that live nowhere else, and that no boolean or enumeration can carry.
value.visual: The filled portion of the track ends at the thumb, and the thumb sits at the value's position along the track.

disabled.description: The platform's own disabled state. Removed from the focus order and cannot be moved.
disabled.visual: The track and thumb dim and the grab cursor is dropped.

dragging.description: A pointer is held down on the thumb and moving it. Tracked by the implementation; no platform provides it.
dragging.visual: The thumb grows slightly and its shadow deepens.

hover.description: The pointer is over the slider and it is not disabled.

focus-visible.visual: A ring is drawn around the thumb.

a11y.keyboard: Arrow keys move by one step, Page Up and Page Down by a larger jump, Home and End to the ends.
notes: The slider has no accessible name of its own and must be given one. Unnamed, it is announced only as a number.

A bare number is meaningless for some ranges — a five-point rating, a date, a set of named tiers. Those need text alongside the number, and this contract has no way to declare that the text is required.

The thumb must be at least 44px in its hit area even where it is drawn smaller, or it cannot be operated on a touch screen. The drawn size and the target size are different numbers and only one of them is stated here.

Keyboard operation must reach every step. A range of 0–100 with a step of 1 is 100 arrow presses end to end, which is technically conformant and practically unusable; Page Up and Page Down exist for that and their jump size is not stated in this contract.

children.description: None. The value is a number, not content.

root.description: The slider. Owns the keyboard, the drag and the focus ring.

track.description: The full range, drawn as a line.

fill.description: The portion of the track below the value. Its length IS the value made visible, which is the one thing here that cannot be static CSS.

thumb.description: The grabbable marker. Its position along the track is the value.
